candidates.why: In dwg_fixup_BLOCKS_entities, _objname is set at line 6168 to bit_convert_TU(...) (a fresh malloc from bits.c:2280) when is_uni. Inside the for-loop over entities (line 6180), line 6199-6200 does `if (is_uni) free(_objname);` then `continue` (6201). The next loop iteration re-uses the freed _objname at lines 6197/6242/6263/6282/6300 (LOG_ERROR/LOG_WARN format args), and it is freed again at line 6309 -> use-after-free and double-free across iterations.
Same buffer: freed at line 6200 inside the loop (guarded by is_uni) and then freed again unconditionally at line 6308-6309 after the loop when is_uni -> double free of the bit_convert_TU result.
After the in-loop free at line 6200 and continue at 6201, subsequent iterations reach line 6196-6197 LOG_ERROR which passes the already-freed _objname to the formatter -> read of freed memory.
